verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kosalesu viharati ekasālāyaṁ brāhmaṇagāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Kosalans near the brahmin village of Ekasālā.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṁ deseti.
verses.english: Now, at that time the Buddha was teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly of laypeople.

verses.pali: “ayaṁ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṁ deseti.
verses.english: “The ascetic Gotama is teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly of laypeople.

verses.pali: Yannūnāhaṁ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṁ vicakkhukammāyā”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t I go and pull the wool over their eyes?”

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: Then Māra the Wicked went up to the Buddha and addressed him in verse:
don’t get caught up in favoring and opposing.”
out of compassion for their welfare.

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṁ bhagavā, jānāti maṁ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
verses.english: Then Māra the Wicked, thinking, “The Buddha knows me! The Holy One knows me!” miserable and sad, vanished right there.
